name: 转时间
description: 时间戳与字符串互转：epoch↔ISO、epoch→自定义格式。纯 Date 实现，无需沙箱 API。

inputs.label: 输入（epoch 毫秒/时间字符串）

controls.label: 格式串（epoch-to-fmt 用，如 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss）

emit:
var input = helpers.getInputVar(ctx, node);
var mode = helpers.data(node).mode || 'epoch-to-iso';
var fmt = helpers.jsString(helpers.valueAsString(helpers.data(node).fmt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'));
var out = helpers.outVar(node);
var m = helpers.jsString(mode);
return indent + 'var ' + out + ' = (function(v, mode, fmt){\n' +
  indent + '  if (mode === "iso-to-epoch") {\n' +
  indent + '    return String(new Date(String(v)).getTime());\n' +
  indent + '  }\n' +
  indent + '  var ms = typeof v === "number" ? v : parseInt(String(v).replace(/[^0-9-]/g, ""), 10);\n' +
  indent + '  var d = new Date(ms);\n' +
  indent + '  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "INVALID_DATE";\n' +
  indent + '  if (mode === "epoch-to-iso") return d.toISOString();\n' +
  indent + '  var pad = function(n, w){ n = String(n); while (n.length < (w || 2)) n = "0" + n; return n; };\n' +
  indent + '  var tz = d.getTimezoneOffset();\n' +
  indent + '  var local = new Date(ms - tz * 60000);\n' +
  indent + '  return fmt\n' +
  indent + '    .replace("YYYY", String(local.getFullYear()))\n' +
  indent + '    .replace("MM", pad(local.getMonth() + 1))\n' +
  indent + '    .replace("DD", pad(local.getDate()))\n' +
  indent + '    .replace("HH", pad(local.getHours()))\n' +
  indent + '    .replace("mm", pad(local.getMinutes()))\n' +
  indent + '    .replace("ss", pad(local.getSeconds()));\n' +
  indent + '})(' + input + ', ' + m + ', ' + fmt + ');\n';
